body: One more Site 2 remainder for the record: **standalone Terminal-Bench 4.0 / SciCode benchmark perspectives**. Site 2 lets either benchmark drive its explorer directly. Here, Terminal-Bench survives as a CAI component score (observations table + detail cards) and SciCode is not carried by the fleet feed at all — a standalone-benchmark perspective needs feed data for both before it can be built.

## Intake review

_Fleet monitor intake enrichment, 2026-10-27._

**Liveness:** still live — this issue IS the remainder list from the merged parity PR #1390; no merged PR since implements these remainders (checked merged-PR titles this run).

**Notes:** A bundle of independent follow-ups, not one change. Suggested approach: split per site/chart area into separate small PRs against the parity code from #1390, starting with the lane charts (same band math, rendering only — lowest risk). The comparison-line overlays need the frontier/trend math documented in Site 1's Data & methods tab.

**Risks:** scope creep — the per-chart view-settings item is a settings system in miniature; sequence it last or split it out.
